title: Announcing the Artificial Analysis Search Index: Same Agent, Different Search
summary: The Artificial Analysis Search Index benchmarks how search API providers perform on quality, cost, and speed when used by an agent. We compare different Search API providers across a series of search-related benchmarks using the same agentic setup.
